title: Drip & Micro Irrigation: Save Water, Increase Yield
description: Precision water delivery techniques reducing water usage by 40-60% while improving fertilizer efficiency through fertigation.

title: Comprehensive Wheat Cultivation & Nutrient Management
description: End-to-end agronomical practices from seed treatment with bio-fertilizers to balanced NPK application and timely harvesting.
source: ICAR - Indian Institute of Wheat and Barley Research

title: Integrated Pest Management (IPM) in Cotton & Paddy
description: Biological controls, pheromone traps, and bio-pesticides to combat Pink Bollworm and stem borers naturally without chemical over-reliance.
source: DD Kisan / Directorate of Plant Protection, Quarantine & Storage

title: Direct Seeded Rice (DSR) Technique for Water Saving
description: Direct seeding of paddy using tar-wattar technique saves up to 20% groundwater, reduces labor costs, and curbs methane emissions.
source: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) & Ministry of Agriculture

title: Soil Health Management: Interpreting Soil Health Cards
description: How to decipher macro and micro-nutrient values on your Soil Health Card to avoid over-fertilization and restore soil organic carbon.
source: Soil Health Card Scheme, Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare

title: High-Density Mango Plantation & Canopy Management
description: Modern canopy architecture, pruning schedules, and micro-nutrient sprays for higher yields per acre in commercial Alphonso and Kesar orchards.

title: Modern Dairy Farm Management & Balanced Feed Formulation
description: Total Mixed Ration (TMR) feeding strategies, hygienic milking practices, and mastitis prevention for crossbred cows and Murrah buffaloes.
source: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD)

title: Success Story: Solar Pump Adoption in Marathwada
description: How smallholder farmer Ramesh Patil doubled his cropping intensity by shifting from grid-dependent irrigation to PM-KUSUM solar micro-irrigation.
source: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)

title: Zero Budget Natural Farming (ZBNF) & Jeevamrutha Preparation
description: Step-by-step formulation of Jeevamrutha, Beejamrutha, and mulching methods to regenerate soil biology using indigenous cow dung and urine.
source: National Centre for Organic and Natural Farming (NCONF)

title: High Yielding Sugarcane Trench Planting & Trash Mulching
description: Deep trench method spacing at 4-5 feet intervals combined with in-situ trash mulching to save water and achieve 100+ tonnes/hectare yield.
source: ICAR - Indian Institute of Sugarcane Research (IISR), Lucknow

title: Video Guide: Setting Up Solar Polyhouse & Protected Cultivation
description: Technical walkthrough of climate-controlled polyhouses for exotic vegetables, seed nurseries, and off-season capsicum and cucumber cultivation.
source: Central Arid Zone Research Institute (CAZRI) & DD Kisan

title: Success Story: Women SHG's Organic Millet Processing Unit
description: How 25 women farmers in Koraput established a collective millet value addition enterprise under the Odisha Millets Mission, tripling household earnings.

title: Millets (Shree Anna): Climate-Resilient Cultivation & Nutrition
description: Complete package of practices for Ragi (Finger Millet), Jowar (Sorghum), and Bajra in rainfed areas with minimal water inputs.
source: ICAR - Indian Institute of Millets Research (IIMR), Hyderabad

title: Article: Understanding Climate-Smart Agriculture & Carbon Credits
description: How smallholder farmers can adopt agroforestry, reduced tillage, and biochar to earn supplemental revenue through carbon offset programs.
source: National Innovations in Climate Resilient Agriculture (NICRA)

title: Pomegranate Bacterial Blight & Wilt Management
description: Crucial protocols to protect Bhagwa pomegranate orchards from Telya (Bacterial blight) using copper sprays and certified disease-free saplings.
source: ICAR - National Research Centre on Pomegranate, Solapur

title: FPO Formation, Working Capital & e-NAM Market Linkages
description: A comprehensive walkthrough on establishing Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), accessing collateral-free credit, and trading on e-NAM.
